limitations: No verbal exchange, written text, or contextual signage confirms intentional symbolism.

alternative_interpretations: The man’s arm may merely stabilize the child for comfort, not symbolize ethical support.
limitations: The man’s exact hand placement and muscle tension cannot be assessed; intent is unobservable.
